title: Void Strike 65
tagline: A vertical space shooter: one fighter, a capital-ship corridor and a boss at the end of the level.
description: You fly one fighter through contested space, alone, against everything that is already there: open space, then the corridor between two capital ships fighting each other, then the boss. Written in 6502 assembly and C for a PAL Atari 65XE/800XL. Unfinished: level 1 and its boss are playable.

screenshots.alt: The fighter between the allied and the hostile capital ship
The boss: a wide armoured band firing a purple laser at the fighter
The main menu: START GAME, OPTIONS, TOP SCORES, EXIT
